extensionDescription.message: Developer tools for Cloudflare Workers on your production domains.

sidepanelTokenMissingBody.message: Add a Cloudflare API token to start using this extension.

badgeTitleNoToken.message: No Cloudflare API token configured. Click to set one up.

panelTabAddInvalid.message: Enter a valid hostname or URL.

detectionModePopoverDescription.message: Auto mode checks every site you switch to against your Cloudflare accounts. Manual mode only shows the hostname until you choose to check it — nothing about the sites you browse leaves your machine until you ask.

manualDetectionPendingBody.message: Manual detection mode is on, so this site hasn't been checked against your Cloudflare accounts yet.

versionSwitcherNotAWorkerSite.message: This site isn't served by a Cloudflare Worker you have access to.

versionSwitcherErrorUnauthenticated.message: Your API token is invalid or expired.

versionSwitcherErrorForbidden.message: Your API token doesn't have permission to inspect this Worker.

versionSwitcherErrorRateLimited.message: Too many requests to the Cloudflare API. Try again shortly.

versionSwitcherErrorUnknown.message: Something went wrong looking up this Worker.

versionSwitcherNoVersions.message: No deployment found for this Worker.

deploymentSplitConfirmDialogDescription.message: This will immediately change live production traffic.

overrideModeBarPinned.message: Pinned to $NAME$ — this tab only, live traffic is unaffected

dashboardMenuWorker.message: Open this Worker in the Cloudflare dashboard

deploymentBarHandleLabel.message: Drag to adjust the traffic split between the two versions

deploymentBarNoteRandom.message: You're currently hitting either version at random — refreshing may switch you. Pin ⌖ a version to reliably reproduce it.

deploymentBarNotePinned.message: This tab is locked to the pinned version — live traffic is unaffected. Remember to unpin when you're done investigating; while pinned, you won't see real production behavior.

deploymentBarNoteSingle.message: Single-version deployment — every request is served by it.

deploymentBarDeltaAffected.message: About $PERCENT$% of users will switch versions

deploymentBarDeltaNoChange.message: No one flips unless you deploy this

deploymentBarWarningRetreat.message: A retreat flips the same share of users as an advance would. If you just want to pause and observe, leaving this alone costs nothing.

deploymentBarWarningPushToFull.message: Pushing to 100% removes the other version from the deployment — it can no longer be pinned afterward.

deploymentBarWarningZeroPinnable.message: At 0% this version is still part of the deployment, and can still be pinned to verify it.

deploymentBarWarningSlotAChanged.message: The first slot's version changed too — this is no longer a gradual rollout but two new versions side by side, so every Durable Object's affinity will be recalculated.

deploymentBarEmptyDescription.message: Choose a version to make the first deployment.

bindingUsageR2.message: $CLASS_A$ Class A · $CLASS_B$ Class B ops · $SIZE$ stored

versionSwitcherPermissionDenied.message: Permission to modify requests to this site was denied.

versionSwitcherActivationError.message: Something went wrong activating the preview. Try again.

recentErrorsEmpty.message: No errors in the last 30 minutes.

recentErrorsObservabilityDisabled.message: This Worker doesn't have Observability/Logs enabled, so no data is being captured — this isn't the same as "no errors".

optionsCreateTokenLink.message: Create a token with the right permissions

optionsTokenNameHelp.message: Couldn't automatically detect an identity for this token — give it a name so you can tell it apart from your other tokens.

optionsVerifyFailureRateLimited.message: Too many requests to the Cloudflare API. Try again shortly.
